responsibility: This file implements the core type-conversion logic for lowering Modula-2 values into GCC trees. It handles checked and unchecked conversions, conversion warnings for lossy or signedness-changing operations, string-to-array conversions, and special SYSTEM/ISO byte-word reinterpretation rules that materialize aggregate constructors in target endianness, making it the frontend’s main VAL/cast coercion layer between expression trees and gm2 type nodes.
same_name_distinction: This file contains the actual conversion machinery: warning analysis for unsafe conversions, checked conversion building, string-to-array conversion, pointer conversion, and special ISO byte/word aggregate reinterpretation logic. The .def and .h variants only publish entry points to that implementation.
